entries.title: A generation is a four-phase loop
entries.summary: Run turn order, research, action, then production. During the action phase, players keep cycling around the table until all have passed; production then resets the economy for the next generation.

entries.title: Taking two actions is optional; passing is final
entries.summary: On an action turn, take one or two actions in any combination, or pass. Passing removes you from the remaining action phase, so do it only when you are finished for the generation.

entries.title: Terraforming raises both a global track and TR
entries.summary: Whenever a global parameter rises, increase the acting player’s Terraform Rating by the permitted amount. Once a parameter is at its goal, additional effects may still resolve but do not raise TR for that parameter.

entries.title: Convert energy before receiving production
entries.summary: At production, convert remaining energy to heat first. Then receive money from TR plus money production and add the other produced resources. Used blue-card actions become available again for the next generation.

entries.title: The last generation gets a final conversion window
entries.summary: When temperature, oxygen, and oceans all reach their goals, finish that generation through production. Then players get one final player-order opportunity to convert plants to greenery before final scoring.

entries.title: Final scoring layers TR, awards, milestones, board, and cards
entries.summary: Score in layers: ending TR, awards, milestones, map tiles, then card points/resources. The highest total wins; the document uses money as the tie-breaker.
